title: Oval Combination Shower Basket - 18.75-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount, Concealed Screw Mounting, Traditional Style, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep bottles and bars neatly organized in your shower without cluttering ledges or corners. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty, this wall-mounted shower basket is crafted from solid brass for enduring bathroom performance.

  • Creates a tidy, easy-to-reach storage spot for daily shower essentials
  • Wall-mount design saves space and keeps items off the tub or shower floor
  • Concealed screw mounting delivers a clean, finished look on the wall
  • Solid brass wires are rust proof and will never rust
  • Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces in a coordinated traditional look.

Specs
- Product type: Oval combination shower basket (shower caddy)
- Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw mounting system
- Material: Solid brass
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 18.75 in x 2.25 in x 4.13 in (projection 4.13 in)
- Weight: 4.8 lb
- Included: Basket and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
meta_description: Organize your bath with a solid brass wall-mount shower basket, 18.75 in long, with concealed screws and rust-proof wires. Limited lifetime warranty.

variants.body_html:
Keep bottles and bars neatly organized in your shower without cluttering ledges or corners — available in Pink, which brings playful, modern energy to bathroom design, offering a fresh take on hardware that celebrates individuality. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty, this wall-mounted shower basket is crafted from solid brass for enduring bathroom performance.

  • Pink transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Concealed screw mounting delivers a clean, finished look on the wall
  • Solid brass wires are rust proof and will never rust
  • Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces in a coordinated traditional look.

Specs
- Product type: Oval combination shower basket (shower caddy)
- Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw mounting system
- Material: Solid brass
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 18.75 in x 2.25 in x 4.13 in (projection 4.13 in)
- Weight: 4.8 lb
- Included: Basket and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
